concept.title: API limitations y security constraints actuales
concept.shortdesc: BPM 0.9.0 documenta claramente las limitations actuales para que las integraciones no infieran guarantees no expuestas.

section.title: Security constraints
section.p: La API actual no tiene authentication ni authorization layer. CORS usa por defecto origins * salvo que deployment settings lo sustituyan. La documentación no debe implicar API token authentication, OAuth, role-based access control, tenant isolation ni production authorization behavior.

section.title: Versioning and compatibility
section.p: La API no tiene version prefix, compatibility policy, deprecation header ni media-type version. Las integraciones deben fijar la BPM release probada y vigilar /openapi.json, el API inventory y release notes, no asumir guaranteed backward compatibility.

section.title: Concurrency, idempotency, and retry
section.p: Solo PATCH admite optimistic concurrency mediante expected_revision opcional. Create, import, delete, restore, reset y export no exponen ETags, precondition headers, idempotency keys ni retry contracts. Consumers deben diseñar su propio safe retry y duplicate-name recovery behavior.

section.title: Bulk and transaction boundaries
section.p: BPM 0.9.0 no expone bulk profile CRUD endpoint, bulk export endpoint, cursor pagination ni multi-operation transaction contract. Una failed multi-step integration no se revierte automáticamente por BPM; el integrating product posee recovery sequencing y audit records.

section.title: Error envelope limitations
section.p: Error responses no usan un stable versioned envelope único. Status 400, 404, 409, 415, 422 y 503 pueden llevar diferentes detail shapes. Consumers deben ramificar por operation, status y documented body shape.

section.title: Excluded and HTML surfaces
section.p: Las seis OpenAPI web operations son HTML product routes, no stable machine-integration APIs. /i18n/{locale}.json, /favicon.ico, /static/*, generated schema UIs y underscore-prefixed Python helpers quedan excluidos de integration operation topics.

section.title: Health response limits
section.p: /health y /health/ready exponen solo compact status fields. Readiness no reporta per-dependency diagnostics, database details, schema health, documentation portal status ni deployment approval. Operational monitors deben tratarlos como minimal handshake endpoints.
